label: TP
reason: Two vulnerabilities identified: 1) XSS: User input from request.getCookies() flows to response.getWriter() without encoding (Lines 96-101). 2) Insecure Randomness: java.util.Random is used for cryptographic tokens (Line 86). Both represent genuine security risks.

evidence.note: User input from request.getCookies() is concatenated into response without encoding
Use of java.util.Random for cryptographic tokens is insecure
